The 70 remaining rows have individual native/JS mappings in data-template-acceptance.md and the records. Full package: 78 runtime files/708 PASS/0 FAIL; focused definitions eight groups; native template probe three groups; site 81/81 pass with no skips. scope_complete stays false for the remaining full-plan/platform/package/performance gates.

2026-11-16 definition/traits/family acceptance: 131 unique declarations, 59 locally verified, 72 partial and zero pending. Seven focused data-definition groups, full package 77 suites/698 PASS/0 FAIL, 81 site tests and native value/raw/unique/shared pointer assertions pass. Native naming uses LLVM 18 headers with conflicting CPATH/CPLUS_INCLUDE_PATH removed for this command only. Exact remaining data constructor/template contracts, Core/19, optional modules, platform and whole-plan acceptance remain open.
All 131 compiler declaration tuples, aliases, overloads and repeated inline definitions are preserved.
Dynamic schemas use actual FamilyBase allocator identities and native RegisterDefinition, not casts from arbitrary host integers.
Core stores addresses in expressions/default views/controllers and re-resolves descendants each use; roots have stable native storage.
Native bool bytes are not exposed in numeric typed arrays; narrow integers promote to supported Variant arithmetic types on reads.
No full module, 1k/10k/100k performance, cross-platform or published package acceptance is inferred from these local tests.

Enums and genuine custom VariableDefinition callbacks/payloads have local acceptance; named-schema template/pointer representations remain partial. Member accessors, scalar callback and advanced alias overloads, actual views/controllers, all official applications and measured performance/platform/package acceptance remain open.

Scoped storage/backing/resize-copy/checked-scalar/runtime-entry counts and RSS/heap deltas are recorded in data-performance.md and CSV. Broader A08 p50/p95, native/JS compute, glyph/mesh/retention, engine-wide profiling, platform and whole-plan acceptance remain open.

2026-11-16 address stage: default invalid handles, explicit mutable name/index entries copied into checked native paths, static int32 literal creation/binding, native bound-root snapshots, registered definition reflection and host receiver callback types are implemented. Full runtime: 68 files/615 PASS/0 FAIL. All 131 IDs remain unique: 48 local, 79 partial, four pending.
